name: Notice of Employee Drug Conviction to Federal Grantor Agencies
description: Notice of an employee's drug conviction to any federal grantor agency (Drug-Free Workplace Act).
recipient: Federal agencies that grant funds to the District
deadline: Within 10 days after receiving notice of the conviction
quote: Within ten (10) days after receiving notice of the conviction of a District employee, the District shall notify any federal agency or department that is the grantor of funds to the District.
